tos.title: Terms of Service
tos.sec1Body: By creating an account or using Verdance, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the app.
tos.sec2Body: Verdance is a personal Bible study tool. Use it only for lawful purposes. Do not post, share or send content that is hateful, abusive, sexual, violent, spam or otherwise objectionable, and do not harass or impersonate anyone. We have no tolerance for objectionable content or abusive users. You can report or block any user from their profile. We review reports within 24 hours and remove content and accounts that break these rules.
tos.sec3Body: The AI chat feature sends your messages to third-party AI providers (OpenRouter and Anthropic Claude) to generate responses. AI-generated content is for study and informational purposes only and does not constitute theological, legal, medical, or professional advice.
tos.sec4Body: AI features consume credits. Credits are non-refundable once used. Subscriptions are billed through the App Store or Google Play, depending on your device, and follow that store’s refund policy. Manage or cancel them in your store account settings. We do not process payments directly.
tos.sec5Body: You retain ownership of the flashcards, notes, and study plans you create. By using Verdance, you grant us a limited license to store and process your content solely to provide the service to you.
tos.sec6Body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms. You may delete your account at any time from Settings → Delete Account.
tos.sec7Body: Verdance is provided “as is” without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted, error-free, or that AI responses will be accurate or complete.
tos.sec8Body: For questions about these terms, contact us at ddtechservices.work@gmail.com.
tos.sum1: Verdance is for personal Bible study. Use it lawfully and kindly.
tos.sum2: AI answers come from outside AI providers. They help you study but are not professional advice.
tos.sum3: Credits can’t be refunded once used. Your app store handles subscription billing and refunds.
tos.sum4: Your cards, notes and plans stay yours. You can delete your account any time in Settings.
tos.sumNote: This summary helps you read the terms. The full terms below are what apply.

legal.tosSec1Body: By creating an account or using Verdance, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the app.
legal.tosSec2Body: Verdance provides digital Bible study tools including flashcard creation, study plans, AI-assisted Scripture analysis, note-taking, and community features. Some features require an active internet connection or study credits.
legal.tosSec3Body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. You must be at least 13 years old to create an account. You agree to provide accurate registration information.
legal.tosSec4Body: Free accounts receive a daily credit allotment. Premium subscriptions provide additional features and higher credit allowances. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the billing period through your Apple ID settings.
legal.tosSec5Body: AI-generated responses are provided for educational and study purposes. Verdance makes no guarantees regarding theological precision or completeness. AI features must not be used to generate harmful, offensive, or inappropriate content.
legal.tosSec6Body: You retain ownership of the study sets, notes, and cards you create. By making a set public, you grant other users a non-exclusive license to view and copy that set for personal study.
legal.tosSec7Body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms, engage in abusive behavior, or attempt to circumvent security or usage limits.
legal.tosSec8Body:
Questions about these Terms should be sent to:
